# Gx Protocol Analyser — Technical Specification

## Table of Contents

1. [Overview](#overview)
2. [Goals & Non-Goals](#goals--non-goals)
3. [System Architecture](#system-architecture)
4. [Technology Stack](#technology-stack)
5. [Core Components](#core-components)
6. [Data Models](#data-models)
7. [Feature Specifications](#feature-specifications)
8. [UI/UX Design](#uiux-design)
9. [File Format Support](#file-format-support)
10. [API Design](#api-design)
11. [Testing Strategy](#testing-strategy)
12. [Directory Structure](#directory-structure)
13. [Implementation Phases](#implementation-phases)

---

## 1. Overview

The **Gx Protocol Analyser** is a desktop/web-based tool for capturing, decoding, visualising, and analysing **Diameter Gx interface messages** — the policy and charging control (PCC) protocol used between a Policy and Charging Rules Function (**PCRF**) and a Policy and Charging Enforcement Function (**PCEF**) in 3GPP LTE/EPC networks.

The tool targets telecom engineers, network architects, and QA teams who need to:

- Inspect raw Diameter AVP trees in human-readable form
- Filter and search large message traces
- Validate messages against 3GPP TS 29.212 rules
- Detect anomalies and sequencing errors in sessions
- Export annotated reports

---

## 2. Goals & Non-Goals

### Goals
- Parse and decode Diameter Gx messages (CCR/CCA, RAR/RAA, STR/STA, ASR/ASA)
- Support PCAP / PCAPNG file import and live capture (libpcap)
- Display full AVP tree with names, values, and RFC references
- Filter messages by session, command code, result code, IMSI, APN, IP
- Validate messages against 3GPP TS 29.212 / RFC 6733 rules
- Sequence diagram view for a selected session
- Statistics dashboard (message rates, error rates, latency)
- Export to JSON, CSV, PDF report
- Dark/light theme

### Non-Goals
- Full PCRF/PCEF simulation
- Support for non-Gx Diameter interfaces (Gy, Sy, S6a) in v1.0
- Real-time packet injection/replay in v1.0

---

## 3. System Architecture

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                        Frontend (React)                      │
│  ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌───────────────┐  │
│  │ Packet   │ │ AVP Tree │ │ Sequence │ │  Statistics   │  │
│  │ List     │ │ Viewer   │ │ Diagram  │  │  Dashboard   │  │
│  └──────────┘ └──────────┘ └──────────┘ └───────────────┘  │
│                    Zustand State Store                        │
└──────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────┘
                           │ REST + WebSocket
┌──────────────────────────▼──────────────────────────────────┐
│                     Backend (Python / FastAPI)                │
│  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────────┐   │
│  │ PCAP Parser  │  │  Diameter    │  │  Gx Validator    │   │
│  │ (Scapy/      │  │  Decoder     │  │  (TS 29.212)     │   │
│  │  pyshark)    │  │              │  │                  │   │
│  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘  └──────────────────┘   │
│  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────────┐   │
│  │ Session      │  │  Statistics  │  │  Export Engine   │   │
│  │ Tracker      │  │  Engine      │  │  (JSON/CSV/PDF)  │   │
│  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘  └──────────────────┘   │
└──────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────┘
                           │
              ┌────────────▼────────────┐
              │    SQLite Database       │
              │  (sessions, packets,     │
              │   AVPs, statistics)      │
              └─────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 4. Technology Stack

| Layer | Technology | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| Frontend | React 18 + TypeScript | Component model, rich ecosystem |
| State Management | Zustand | Lightweight, no boilerplate |
| UI Components | shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS | Accessible, composable |
| Charting | Recharts | React-native, declarative |
| Sequence Diagrams | Custom SVG renderer | Full control over layout |
| Backend | Python 3.11 + FastAPI | Async, fast, great for parsing |
| PCAP Parsing | Scapy + pyshark | Combined raw + Wireshark dissection |
| Diameter Decoding | Custom Python decoder | Full AVP dictionary control |
| Database | SQLite via SQLAlchemy | Zero-config, portable |
| PDF Export | ReportLab | Mature Python PDF library |
| Packaging | Electron (optional desktop wrap) | Single binary distribution |
| Build Tool | Vite | Fast HMR, ESM-native |

---

## 5. Core Components

### 5.1 Backend Components

#### `PcapIngester`
- Accepts file path or live interface name
- Uses Scapy to iterate frames → extracts Ethernet/IP/TCP/SCTP layers
- Identifies Diameter messages by port 3868 (TCP/SCTP)
- Reassembles TCP streams before passing to decoder
- Emits raw bytes + metadata (timestamp, src/dst IP, port)

#### `DiameterDecoder`
- Parses Diameter base protocol header (RFC 6733)
  - Version, Message Length, Flags (R/P/E/T), Command Code, Application ID, Hop-by-Hop ID, End-to-End ID
- Recursively decodes AVPs: Code, Vendor-ID, Flags (M/V/P), Length, Value
- Uses bundled AVP dictionary (`avp_dictionary.json`) mapping codes → name, type, enum values
- Supports Grouped AVPs with recursive descent
- Handles all Gx-specific AVPs (3GPP Vendor ID 10415)

#### `GxValidator`
- Validates mandatory AVPs per command (CCR-I, CCR-U, CCR-T, CCA, RAR, RAA, STR, STA, ASR, ASA)
- Checks Result-Code / Experimental-Result semantics
- Validates CC-Request-Number sequencing
- Checks Charging-Rule-Install / Remove consistency
- Emits structured `ValidationResult` objects with severity (ERROR/WARNING/INFO)

#### `SessionTracker`
- Tracks Diameter sessions via Session-Id AVP
- Links CCR/CCA pairs via Hop-by-Hop ID
- Computes request→response latency
- Detects orphaned requests, duplicate Session-IDs, missing STR

#### `StatisticsEngine`
- Per-session: message count, error rate, avg latency, duration
- Global: messages/sec, command code distribution, result code histogram
- Time-bucket aggregation for time-series charts

#### `ExportEngine`
- JSON: full decoded message tree
- CSV: flat tabular view of packet list
- PDF: formatted report with summary, statistics, message details

### 5.2 Frontend Components

#### `PacketListPanel`
- Virtualised table (react-window) for large traces
- Columns: #, Timestamp, Src IP, Dst IP, Command, Session-Id, Result-Code, Flags, Length
- Row colour-coding: green (success), red (error), yellow (warning), blue (request)
- Click to select → updates AVP tree and detail panels

#### `AvpTreePanel`
- Tree view of selected message's AVP hierarchy
- Expand/collapse grouped AVPs
- Each node: AVP name, code, vendor, flags, decoded value, raw hex
- Copy value / raw bytes to clipboard
- Highlight mandatory-but-missing AVPs in red

#### `SequenceDiagramPanel`
- Renders MSC (Message Sequence Chart) for selected session
- Entities: PCEF (left), PCRF (right)
- Arrows labelled with Command Code + CC-Request-Type
- Timeline with timestamps
- Click arrow → selects packet in list

#### `StatsDashboard`
- Cards: total messages, unique sessions, error rate, avg latency
- Bar chart: command code distribution
- Line chart: messages over time
- Pie chart: result code breakdown
- Table: top 10 sessions by message count

#### `FilterBar`
- Free-text search across all decoded fields
- Dropdown filters: Command Code, CC-Request-Type, Result-Code range
- IMSI / APN / IP address filters
- Time range picker
- "Save filter preset" functionality

#### `HexViewer`
- Raw hex dump of selected packet
- Offset | Hex | ASCII columns
- Highlight bytes corresponding to selected AVP

---

## 6. Data Models

### 6.1 Database Schema (SQLAlchemy / SQLite)

```sql
-- Capture session (file or live)
CREATE TABLE captures (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name        TEXT NOT NULL,
    source      TEXT NOT NULL,       -- filename or interface
    captured_at DATETIME,
    created_at  DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    packet_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0
);

-- Individual Diameter messages
CREATE TABLE packets (
    id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    capture_id      INTEGER REFERENCES captures(id),
    frame_number    INTEGER,
    timestamp       REAL NOT NULL,   -- Unix epoch with microseconds
    src_ip          TEXT,
    dst_ip          TEXT,
    src_port        INTEGER,
    dst_port        INTEGER,
    transport       TEXT,            -- TCP / SCTP
    version         INTEGER,
    msg_length      INTEGER,
    flags           INTEGER,
    is_request      BOOLEAN,
    is_proxyable    BOOLEAN,
    is_error        BOOLEAN,
    is_retransmit   BOOLEAN,
    command_code    INTEGER,
    application_id  INTEGER,
    hop_by_hop_id   INTEGER,
    end_to_end_id   INTEGER,
    session_id      TEXT,
    raw_hex         TEXT,
    validation_status TEXT           -- VALID / WARNING / ERROR
);

-- Decoded AVPs (flattened for search)
CREATE TABLE avps (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    packet_id   INTEGER REFERENCES packets(id),
    parent_id   INTEGER REFERENCES avps(id),  -- NULL = top-level
    avp_code    INTEGER,
    vendor_id   INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    avp_name    TEXT,
    avp_type    TEXT,
    raw_value   TEXT,
    decoded_value TEXT,
    is_mandatory BOOLEAN,
    depth       INTEGER DEFAULT 0
);

-- Diameter sessions
CREATE TABLE sessions (
    id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    capture_id      INTEGER REFERENCES captures(id),
    session_id_str  TEXT NOT NULL,
    imsi            TEXT,
    apn             TEXT,
    ue_ip           TEXT,
    start_time      REAL,
    end_time        REAL,
    duration_ms     REAL,
    packet_count    INTEGER,
    error_count     INTEGER,
    status          TEXT             -- ACTIVE / TERMINATED / ORPHANED
);

-- Validation findings
CREATE TABLE validation_results (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    packet_id   INTEGER REFERENCES packets(id),
    severity    TEXT,                -- ERROR / WARNING / INFO
    rule_id     TEXT,
    message     TEXT,
    avp_code    INTEGER
);
```

### 6.2 Python Pydantic Models

```python
class DiameterHeader(BaseModel):
    version: int
    msg_length: int
    is_request: bool
    is_proxyable: bool
    is_error: bool
    is_retransmit: bool
    command_code: int
    command_name: str
    application_id: int
    hop_by_hop_id: int
    end_to_end_id: int

class AVP(BaseModel):
    code: int
    vendor_id: int
    name: str
    avp_type: str
    flags: AVPFlags
    length: int
    raw_value: str        # hex string
    decoded_value: Any
    children: List['AVP'] # for Grouped AVPs

class DiameterMessage(BaseModel):
    frame_number: int
    timestamp: float
    src_ip: str
    dst_ip: str
    src_port: int
    dst_port: int
    transport: str
    header: DiameterHeader
    avps: List[AVP]
    raw_hex: str
    session_id: Optional[str]

class ValidationResult(BaseModel):
    severity: Literal['ERROR', 'WARNING', 'INFO']
    rule_id: str
    message: str
    avp_code: Optional[int]

class Session(BaseModel):
    session_id_str: str
    imsi: Optional[str]
    apn: Optional[str]
    ue_ip: Optional[str]
    packets: List[int]    # packet IDs in order
    start_time: float
    end_time: Optional[float]
    status: str
```

---

## 7. Feature Specifications

### 7.1 File Import
- Drag-and-drop or file dialog for `.pcap` / `.pcapng`
- Progress bar with frame count
- Background processing — UI stays responsive
- Duplicate detection (SHA-256 hash of file)

### 7.2 Live Capture
- List available network interfaces (via Scapy)
- BPF filter input (default: `port 3868`)
- Start/Stop/Pause controls
- Real-time packet streaming via WebSocket

### 7.3 Message Decoding
- All standard Diameter command codes relevant to Gx:
  - 272 — Credit-Control (CCR/CCA)
  - 258 — Re-Auth (RAR/RAA)
  - 274 — Abort-Session (ASR/ASA)
  - 275 — Session-Termination (STR/STA)
- Full 3GPP Gx AVP dictionary (TS 29.212 + TS 29.061)
- Enumerated value decoding (e.g., CC-Request-Type: 1=INITIAL_REQUEST)
- IP address, time, OctetString, UTF8String, Integer32/64 type rendering

### 7.4 Filtering & Search
- Combined AND filter across: Command Code, Result-Code, Session-Id, IMSI, APN, Src/Dst IP, Time Range
- Regex search on decoded AVP values
- "Follow session" — filter to all packets in same session
- Filter negation (`NOT`) support
- Filters preserved across panel navigation

### 7.5 Validation Rules

| Rule ID | Severity | Description |
|---------|----------|-------------|
| GX-001 | ERROR | Missing mandatory Session-Id AVP |
| GX-002 | ERROR | Missing mandatory Origin-Host AVP |
| GX-003 | ERROR | Missing mandatory Origin-Realm AVP |
| GX-004 | ERROR | CCR missing CC-Request-Type |
| GX-005 | ERROR | CCR missing CC-Request-Number |
| GX-006 | ERROR | Subscription-Id missing Sub-Type |
| GX-007 | WARNING | CC-Request-Number not sequential |
| GX-008 | WARNING | Response latency > 2 seconds |
| GX-009 | WARNING | Session has no STR (orphaned) |
| GX-010 | ERROR | Invalid Result-Code value |
| GX-011 | WARNING | Duplicate Session-Id detected |
| GX-012 | INFO | RAR sent before CCA-Initial received |
| GX-013 | ERROR | Charging-Rule-Name empty string |
| GX-014 | WARNING | Missing Framed-IP-Address in CCR-I |

### 7.6 Statistics
- Computed after import / updated live during capture
- Exportable as CSV snapshot

### 7.7 Export
- **JSON**: Complete decoded trace (single message or all)
- **CSV**: Packet list columns + top-level AVP values
- **PDF**: Executive summary + statistics charts + message details

---

## 8. UI/UX Design

### Layout (Three-Panel)

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ [☰ Logo] Gx Analyser   [Open File] [Live Capture] [Export] │
├──────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┤
│ FILTER BAR           │                                       │
│ [Search...] [Cmd▼]   │                                       │
│ [Result▼] [IMSI...]  │                                       │
├──────────────────────┤        AVP TREE PANEL                 │
│                      │                                       │
│   PACKET LIST        │                                       │
│   (virtualised       │                                       │
│    table)            ├──────────────────────────────────────┤
│                      │        HEX VIEWER                     │
│                      │                                       │
├──────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────┤
│ [Packets] [Sessions] [Sequence] [Statistics]  Status bar    │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Colour Coding
- **Blue** row: Diameter Request
- **Green** row: Successful response (2xxx)
- **Red** row: Error response (3xxx/4xxx/5xxx) or validation ERROR
- **Yellow** row: Validation WARNING
- **Grey** row: Informational / retransmit

---

## 9. File Format Support

| Format | Import | Export |
|--------|--------|--------|
| PCAP | ✅ | ❌ |
| PCAPNG | ✅ | ❌ |
| JSON (decoded) | ❌ | ✅ |
| CSV | ❌ | ✅ |
| PDF report | ❌ | ✅ |

---

## 10. API Design

### REST Endpoints

```
POST   /api/captures/upload          — Upload PCAP file
GET    /api/captures                 — List all captures
GET    /api/captures/{id}            — Get capture metadata
DELETE /api/captures/{id}            — Delete capture

GET    /api/captures/{id}/packets    — List packets (paginated, filterable)
GET    /api/packets/{id}             — Full decoded packet detail
GET    /api/packets/{id}/avps        — AVP tree for packet
GET    /api/packets/{id}/hex         — Raw hex dump

GET    /api/captures/{id}/sessions   — List sessions
GET    /api/sessions/{id}            — Session detail + sequence
GET    /api/sessions/{id}/packets    — All packets for session

GET    /api/captures/{id}/stats      — Statistics summary
GET    /api/captures/{id}/validate   — All validation findings

POST   /api/captures/{id}/export/json
POST   /api/captures/{id}/export/csv
POST   /api/captures/{id}/export/pdf

GET    /api/interfaces               — List capture interfaces

WS     /ws/

    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    packet_id   INTEGER REFERENCES packets(id),
    parent_id   INTEGER REFERENCES avps(id),  -- NULL = top-level
    avp_code    INTEGER,
    vendor_id   INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    avp_name    TEXT,
    avp_type    TEXT,
    raw_value   TEXT,
    decoded_value TEXT,
    is_mandatory BOOLEAN,
    depth       INTEGER DEFAULT 0
);

-- Diameter sessions
CREATE TABLE sessions (
    id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    capture_id      INTEGER REFERENCES captures(id),
    session_id_str  TEXT NOT NULL,
    imsi            TEXT,
    apn             TEXT,
    ue_ip           TEXT,
    start_time      REAL,
    end_time        REAL,
    duration_ms     REAL,
    packet_count    INTEGER,
    error_count     INTEGER,
    status          TEXT             -- ACTIVE / TERMINATED / ORPHANED
);

-- Validation findings
CREATE TABLE validation_results (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    packet_id   INTEGER REFERENCES packets(id),
    severity    TEXT,                -- ERROR / WARNING / INFO
    rule_id     TEXT,
    message     TEXT,
    avp_code    INTEGER
);
```

## 7. Feature Specifications

### 7.1 File Import
- Drag-and-drop or file dialog for `.pcap` / `.pcapng`
- Progress bar with frame count
- Background processing — UI stays responsive
- Duplicate detection (SHA-256 hash of file)

### 7.2 Live Capture
- List available network interfaces (via Scapy)
- BPF filter input (default: `port 3868`)
- Start/Stop/Pause controls
- Real-time packet streaming via WebSocket

### 7.3 Message Decoding
- All standard Diameter command codes relevant to Gx:
  - 272 — Credit-Control (CCR/CCA)
  - 258 — Re-Auth (RAR/RAA)
  - 274 — Abort-Session (ASR/ASA)
  - 275 — Session-Termination (STR/STA)
- Full 3GPP Gx AVP dictionary (TS 29.212 + TS 29.061)
- Enumerated value decoding (e.g., CC-Request-Type: 1=INITIAL_REQUEST)
- IP address, time, OctetString, UTF8String, Integer32/64 type rendering

### 7.4 Filtering & Search
- Combined AND filter across: Command Code, Result-Code, Session-Id, IMSI, APN, Src/Dst IP, Time Range
- Regex search on decoded AVP values
- "Follow session" — filter to all packets in same session
- Filter negation (`NOT`) support
- Filters preserved across panel navigation

### 7.5 Validation Rules

| Rule ID | Severity | Description |
|---------|----------|-------------|
| GX-001 | ERROR | Missing mandatory Session-Id AVP |
| GX-002 | ERROR | Missing mandatory Origin-Host AVP |
| GX-003 | ERROR | Missing mandatory Origin-Realm AVP |
| GX-004 | ERROR | CCR missing CC-Request-Type |
| GX-005 | ERROR | CCR missing CC-Request-Number |
| GX-006 | ERROR | Subscription-Id missing Sub-Type |
| GX-007 | WARNING | CC-Request-Number not sequential |
| GX-008 | WARNING | Response latency > 2 seconds |
| GX-009 | WARNING | Session has no STR (orphaned) |
| GX-010 | ERROR | Invalid Result-Code value |
| GX-011 | WARNING | Duplicate Session-Id detected |
| GX-012 | INFO | RAR sent before CCA-Initial received |
| GX-013 | ERROR | Charging-Rule-Name empty string |
| GX-014 | WARNING | Missing Framed-IP-Address in CCR-I |

### 7.6 Statistics
- Computed after import / updated live during capture
- Exportable as CSV snapshot

### 7.7 Export
- **JSON**: Complete decoded trace (single message or all)
- **CSV**: Packet list columns + top-level AVP values
- **PDF**: Executive summary + statistics charts + message details

### Colour Coding
- **Blue** row: Diameter Request
- **Green** row: Successful response (2xxx)
- **Red** row: Error response (3xxx/4xxx/5xxx) or validation ERROR
- **Yellow** row: Validation WARNING
- **Grey** row: Informational / retransmit
